scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies only to the zero-field critical Curie–Weiss Gibbs measure in the stated normalization. The analytic proof is primary; finite-sum computation is corroborative. Older higher-order critical Curie–Weiss literature was not fully inspected, so exhaustive novelty is not asserted.
title: First finite-size correction to critical Curie–Weiss pair dependence
